ns2:section.sectionText: This section will be taught online. Students must have broadband access to the internet to participate. There will be one on-campus organizational meeting in late April or early May to cover logistics and address any questions. Registration restricted thru May 3 to College of Business students; LAS Finance, Actuarial Science, and Econ majors; and ACES Agri-Finance, Agri-Accounting, and Consumer Economics majors. Any remaining seats will open to all interested students at approximately noon on Monday, May 4.
